mLocKeys.keySummary: Viego commands the Black Mist to haunt and surround a piece of terrain. Viego can hide in the Mist as a wraith, gaining camouflage, Move Speed, and Attack Speed.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Viego sends forth a spectre to haunt the first terrain hit, surrounding it with Mist for @MistDuration@ seconds. Viego gains <keywordStealth>Camouflage</keywordStealth>, <speed>@TotalMoveSpeed@ Move Speed</speed>, and <attackSpeed>@AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed</attackSpeed> while inside the Mist.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
{{Reminder_Camouflage}}
Viego reveals himself for @RestealthTime@ seconds whenever he attacks or uses an Ability.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: This unit has increased Attack Speed and Move Speed.
This unit is camouflaged while in the Mist.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Enemies who fall before Viego become wraiths. By attacking a wraith, Viego temporarily seizes control of the dead enemy's body, healing for a percentage of his target's max health and gaining access to their basic abilities and items. He replaces their Ultimate with a free cast of his own.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: The souls of enemy champions that die within @TakedownWindow@ seconds of being hit by Viego become wraiths. Viego can Attack wraiths to <keywordMajor>Possess</keywordMajor> them, restoring <healing>@PercentHealthHeal@% of enemy's max Health</healing> and gaining access to their non-ultimate Abilities, Attacks, and items for @TransformDuration@ seconds. During this time he replaces their Ultimate with a free cast of his own and gains <speed>@MoveSpeedPercent*100@% Move Speed</speed> towards enemy champions.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_ViegoPassive_Tooltip}}

Viego keeps his summoner spells, runes, and trinkets during Possession and cannot use active or consumable items. Passive item Cooldowns are shared across Possessions.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: This soul has become trapped in the mist and can be possessed by Viego.
Viego has dominated the soul of an enemy champion.

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Viego's spectral blade passively deals bonus percent current Health damage On-Hit and strikes twice vs. enemies he recently hit with an Ability, stealing Health.

Viego can activate this Ability to thrust his zweihander forward, impaling enemies in front of him.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Viego's Attacks deal an additional @TotalPercentHealthOnHit@ current Health physical damage. His first Attack against an enemy he has recently damaged with an Ability hits a second time, dealing @SecondAttackDamage@ physical damage and restoring @HealModVsChamps*100@% of damage dealt as Health. These bonuses are kept during Possession.

Active: Viego stabs forward, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
The second strike can Critically Strike and applies %i:OnHit% On-Hit effects while not Possessing an enemy. Its healing is decreased to @HealModVsMonsters*100@% vs. jungle monsters and @HealModVsMinions*100@% vs. minions.
The bonus %i:OnHit% On-Hit damage can critically strike for @HealthCritDamage@ current Health and deals a minimum of @MinDamageOnHit@ damage. It deals a max of @MonsterCapOnHit@ damage vs. jungle monsters.
This Ability's cast time is reduced with Attack Speed. Its damage scales with Critical Strike Chance and Damage at @ActiveCritMod*100@% effectiveness.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: This unit will be hit twice by Viego's next attack.
This unit has reduced move speed (and a broken heart).

mLocKeys.keySummary: Viego teleports to a nearby location and executes an enemy champion on arrival, piercing their heart and causing a destructive shockwave around them that knocks away their allies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Viego discards any souls he is currently <keywordMajor>Possessing</keywordMajor> and teleports. On arrival he Attacks the champion with the lowest percent Health, briefly <status>Slowing</status> them by @SlowPercent*100@% and dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ + @TotalPercentHealth@% missing Health physical damage</physicalDamage>. Other nearby enemies are <status>Knocked Back</status> and take <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage>.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
This Ability applies on-hit effects to the primary target and spell effects to everything else.
Damage scales with Critical Strike Chance and Damage at @CritMod*100@% effectiveness.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: This unit is being knocked back.
Viego's ice egg is on cooldown.
Viego's Sun Disc is on cooldown.
Viego's green colored revive is on cooldown.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Viego charges up before dashing forward, releasing a ball of concentrated Black Mist that stuns the first enemy hit.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Begin Charging: Viego begins gathering Mist, Slowing himself by @SelfSlowPercent*100@%.

Release: Viego dashes forward and hurls the gathered Mist. Deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage and Stuns the first enemy hit for @Stunduration@ to @MaxStunTT@ seconds based on charge time.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>This Ability's Cooldown is set to @CDWheninterrupted@ seconds when interrupted.</rules>
